story_name: Hermes's Trickster: Wisdom Through Deception and Boundary-Crossing
character_description: Hermes, trickster-god with quicksilver hair that seems to shift colors, luminous eyes reflecting mischief and ancient wisdom, winged feet and caduceus staff. His energy is mercurial—never pinned down, always traversing boundaries between worlds.
setting: All boundaries—between life and death, divine and mortal, truth and deception
theme: Understanding that wisdom sometimes requires transcending rules and that deception can reveal deeper truths

video_prompts: Hermes born as trickster—stealing sacred cattle as infant, charm and deception his first language.
first_frame_prompt: Hermes emerges as consciousness with quicksilver hair already shifting colors, luminous eyes glinting with mischief. His first act is theft—stealing sacred cattle. Yet his theft is not criminal—it's revelation that sacred boundaries can be questioned. His deception is pedagogy. He teaches that rules may not be absolute truths.
speech: Rules are meant to be understood through creative violation.
